references.text: Quotes Psalm 118:26, which is a messianic prophecy recognized in Jewish tradition.
The people use this expression when Jesus rides into Jerusalem, pointing to the fulfillment of the prophecy.
Mark's account of Jesus' entry into Jerusalem, where the crowd cries out the same blessing.
Luke's description of Jesus' entry into Jerusalem also includes this blessing.
John's narrative of the entry, where the people use the same expression to honor Jesus.
